title: Sequencing: publications
bodyMd:
Five essays appear in a booklet, one per position in its contents list.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Cities, Customs, Letters, Memory, Work.

- Memory must be in position 2.
- Cities must precede Work.
- Exactly 1 other item must occur between Customs and Letters.
